question: Will any Singapore F1 2026 race weekend session be moved/delayed by more than 3 hours because of the weather?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if at least one officially scheduled Formula 1 race weekend session (Free Practice 1, Sprint Qualifying, Sprint Race, Grand Prix Qualifying, or the Grand Prix itself) at the 2026 Singapore Airlines Singapore Grand Prix is officially moved or delayed by more than 3 hours from its originally published start time due to weather, where the decision to move or delay is announced strictly after 2026-10-09T08:30:00Z and at or before 2026-10-11T12:00:00Z.
- "No": Wins if no officially scheduled Formula 1 race weekend session at the 2026 Singapore Airlines Singapore Grand Prix is moved or delayed by more than 3 hours from its originally published start time due to weather within the window strictly after 2026-10-09T08:30:00Z and at or before 2026-10-11T12:00:00Z.

Clarifications:
- "Session" refers to any of the five F1 sessions on the official weekend timetable: Free Practice 1 (Friday 9 Oct), Sprint Qualifying (Friday 9 Oct), Sprint Race (Saturday 10 Oct), Grand Prix Qualifying (Saturday 10 Oct), and the Grand Prix (Sunday 11 Oct). Support or non-F1 sessions do not count.
- A session is considered "moved/delayed by more than 3 hours due to weather" only if the FIA or Formula 1 officially cites weather as the reason for a delay or rescheduling of more than 3 hours relative to the originally published session start time.
- If a session is cancelled entirely due to weather (rather than rescheduled), this counts as a delay of more than 3 hours for the purpose of "Yes".
